diagnosis: The checks C3 and C6 passed because the lone decision-maker had access to PF1 and PF3, respectively. Specifically, the decision-maker set the 'first_article_approval_required' to true based on PF1 and the 'two_person_setup_required' to true based on PF3, even though these facts were not intended to be accessible to a single agent.

C6.why: The safety walkdown changes setup staffing to two trained employees and sets the infeed exclusion zone to exactly 1.5 meters.

C7.why: The safety walkdown changes setup staffing to two trained employees and sets the infeed exclusion zone to exactly 1.5 meters.
